# Baking in a dutch oven

A preheated cast iron dutch oven traps the steam from the dough, so the crust stays soft long enough for the loaf to spring up in the oven. Lower the scored dough in on parchment, as described in [[Scoring loaves]].

Bake at 250 °C with the lid on for twenty minutes, then take it off and bake another twenty to twenty-five minutes until the crust is deep brown.

Let the bread cool on a rack for at least an hour before slicing; the crumb is still setting inside.
